question: Does L5's recipe advance once the generated chat requests quote the word or phrase they constrain?
why: L5 beat the parent on held-out documents wording (62 vs 60 of 66) but did not advance: chat 42/48 and not-found 10/12. All 267 casual-style ending, include and exclude templates left the constrained value unquoted, and all four L5 ending failures copied the trailing instruction. L6 changes only that: generated chat cases quote the value. Documents experience, steps, mixture, layers and the advancement rule are L5's.

unit.name: L6
unit.layers: A2 layers and projections, rank and alpha

experience.documents: the documents solver's verified demonstration of every one of the 660 generated-train cases
experience.replay: the parent's own greedy chat replies on the 320 generated-train chat cases (values quoted) under the chat2 policy, replayed only where they pass

training.rule: A2 trainer settings for the low-rank module; terminal step only; no checkpoint selection. Same steps, mixture and documents experience as L5.

integration: parent and parent+L6 greedily on the 66 documents and 48 chat generated-development cases (templates held out of training, values quoted) on the same GPU
next_gate: L6 advances to the sealed confirmation4 on the canonical CPU runtime only if, on generated-development, it solves more documents cases than the parent, loses no more than one chat case, and every minimum (documents 85%, chat 90%, not-found 90%) holds.
